text:
maria: quick q on saved-views: do we force single-route + single-model by default or allow multi-model "lenses"? thinking about telemetry/tagging, cost previews, and shareability.

sam: default single seems safest. multi-model adds attribution headaches.

maria: yep default single. but want an opt-in advanced flow for multi-model compare usecases.

kevin: infra notes: if we permit multi-model, every sampled request needs saved_view_id + model_pin_id tags. cost sim must accept routing weights. doable but needs sim extension.

jess: UX: in modal show radio: (o) Save for this route only (recommended)  ( ) Create multi-model lens (advanced). If multi selected, show "partial apply" preview for incompatible routes.

sam: rollout and canaries: saved-views should support rollout_pct + fallback_view_id. console timeline + audit logs required.

kevin: API sketch: id, scope, mode(single|composite), model_pins[], filters, telemetry{sample_rate,tag}, snapshots{perf_baseline_ts}. snapshot models/pools at save-time.

maria: action items: kevin proto+migration, jess mock for modal, sam telemetry tagging. will demo in product sync.

console-bot: feature flag saved_views.composite enabled in staging for QA (:white_check_mark:)

jess: I'll add cost card: per-pin tokens, per-pin cost, blended estimate + uncertainty band when rollout in-flight.

kevin: also add per-view telemetry caps to avoid runaway sampling.

maria: perfect. closing thread.
